title: Ateneo de Zamboanga grade school beefs up security amid threat messages

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Security measures have been tightened at the Ateneo de Zamboanga University (AdZU) Grade School Department, even as school authorities assured the public on Sunday that no substantiated threat had been identified following the circulation of messages alleging a violent attack on the school on Monday, Oct. 19. In an official advisory, the AdZU Grade School administration acknowledged the anxiety caused by the unverified information, noting that the concerns arose just two months after a shooting incident struck the school community on Aug. 18. “Please be assured that we are taking these reports seriously.
